name: March in Place
purpose: Gently raise body temperature before strength exercise.
starting_position: Stand tall near a stable counter or chair.
instructions: Shift your weight comfortably from foot to foot.
Lift one foot a few inches, lower it, then alternate sides.
Let your arms swing naturally and breathe comfortably.
common_mistakes: Lifting the knees higher than is comfortable
easier_alternative: Seated marching in a sturdy chair.
safety_instructions: Keep a stable support within reach if balance is uncertain.
Stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Easy Arm Circles
purpose: Prepare the shoulders with easy, controlled movement.
starting_position: Stand or sit tall with your arms relaxed by your sides.
instructions: Lift your arms only to a comfortable height.
Make small, slow circles forward for half the time.
Reverse direction and keep your shoulders relaxed.
easier_alternative: Roll your shoulders gently with your arms by your sides.
safety_instructions: Stay in a pain-free range and stop if discomfort occurs.

name: Gentle Hip Hinge
purpose: Rehearse a comfortable hip movement before lower-body exercise.
starting_position: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees softly bent.
instructions: Place your hands on your hips.
Send your hips back a small amount while keeping your back comfortable.
Return to standing by gently bringing your hips forward.
easier_alternative: Practice a small hip shift while seated.
safety_instructions: Use a small, pain-free range. Stop if your back or hips hurt.

name: Gentle Shoulder Rolls
purpose: Ease into the session with relaxed upper-body movement.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with arms relaxed.
instructions: Lift your shoulders gently toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a small circle.
Repeat slowly, then reverse direction.
easier_alternative: Make very small shoulder movements or simply relax your arms.
safety_instructions: Keep the movement comfortable and pain-free.

name: Cat-Cow Mobility
purpose: Move the spine gently through a comfortable range.
starting_position: Start on hands and knees on a comfortable surface, or use a seated version.
instructions: Breathe in and gently lift your chest without forcing your back.
Breathe out and softly round your back.
Move slowly between the two positions.
common_mistakes: Forcing the spine into an extreme arch
easier_alternative: Sit upright and gently round and lengthen your upper back.
safety_instructions: Skip kneeling if it is uncomfortable. Stop for back or wrist pain.

name: Chair Squat
purpose: Build comfortable lower-body strength and practice standing control.
starting_position: Stand in front of a stable chair, feet about hip-width apart.
instructions: Send your hips back and bend your knees a comfortable amount.
Lightly touch the chair or sit down with control.
Press through your feet to return to standing.
common_mistakes: Using a depth that feels uncomfortable
easier_alternative: Use a higher chair and your hands for support, or practice a small hip bend.
safety_instructions: Keep a stable chair behind you and use a comfortable range.
Stop for knee pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Bodyweight Squat
purpose: Strengthen the legs with a controlled bodyweight movement.
starting_position: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and a stable support nearby.
instructions: Brace gently and send your hips back.
Bend your knees only as far as comfortable.
Press through your whole foot to stand tall.
easier_alternative: Chair squat or a small supported squat.
safety_instructions: Use a pain-free depth and keep a support within reach.

name: Wall Push-up
purpose: Develop pushing strength with the wall supporting your body.
starting_position: Face a wall and place your hands at chest height, slightly wider than your shoulders.
instructions: Step back a comfortable distance and keep your body aligned.
Bend your elbows and bring your chest gently toward the wall.
Press the wall away to return to your start position.
easier_alternative: Stand closer to the wall and use a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Keep wrists comfortable and stop if shoulder or wrist pain occurs.

name: Incline Push-up
purpose: Build pushing strength using a stable elevated surface.
starting_position: Place hands on a secure counter or sturdy bench at about chest height.
instructions: Step back and keep your body comfortably aligned.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the surface.
Press back up without locking your elbows.
easier_alternative: Wall push-up.
safety_instructions: Use only a stable surface and stop for wrist or shoulder pain.

name: Glute Bridge
purpose: Strengthen the hips and glutes while lying on your back.
starting_position: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, about hip-width apart.
instructions: Breathe out and gently tighten your middle.
Press through your feet and lift your hips only as high as comfortable.
Lower slowly and relax before the next repetition.
easier_alternative: Gently squeeze your glutes without lifting your hips.
safety_instructions: Use a comfortable surface and stop if your back or hips hurt.

name: Bird Dog
purpose: Practice trunk stability and coordinated arm and leg movement.
starting_position: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
instructions: Gently brace your middle and keep your back comfortable.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back only as far as you can stay steady.
Return slowly and switch sides.
easier_alternative: Slide one foot back at a time or reach one arm at a time.
safety_instructions: Use padding under your knees and stop if your back, wrists, or knees hurt.

name: Dead Bug Heel Tap
purpose: Build gentle core control with a small, controlled leg movement.
starting_position: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet on the floor.
instructions: Breathe normally and gently tighten your middle.
Slide or tap one heel a little farther away.
Return it slowly and alternate sides.
common_mistakes: Continuing when your back feels uncomfortable
easier_alternative: Lift one foot just slightly, then return it.
safety_instructions: Keep the movement small and stop if your back feels painful.

name: Wall Plank Hold
purpose: Practice whole-body tension with the wall supporting your upper body.
starting_position: Place forearms or hands on a wall at chest height and step back slightly.
instructions: Keep your body in a comfortable straight line.
Gently tighten your middle and breathe normally.
Hold for the planned time, then step closer to the wall.
easier_alternative: Stand closer to the wall and hold for a shorter time.
safety_instructions: Stop if you feel back, wrist, or shoulder pain.

name: Light Dumbbell Curl
purpose: Strengthen the front of the upper arm using light resistance.
starting_position: Stand or sit tall holding very light dumbbells at your sides.
instructions: Keep elbows near your sides and wrists comfortable.
Bend your elbows to bring the weights upward without swinging.
Lower slowly and keep breathing.
common_mistakes: Choosing a weight that changes your form
easier_alternative: Use lighter weights or practice the curl with empty hands.
safety_instructions: Choose a light load and stop if you feel pain or lose control.

name: Resistance Band Curl
purpose: Strengthen the front of the upper arm with light band resistance.
starting_position: Stand on the middle of a light resistance band and hold one end in each hand.
instructions: Keep elbows close to your sides.
Bend your elbows and bring your hands upward smoothly.
Return slowly without letting the band snap.
common_mistakes: Using a band that is too strong
easier_alternative: Use a lighter band or do slow, unweighted curls.
safety_instructions: Check the band for damage and keep its path away from your face.

name: Seated Resistance Band Row
purpose: Practice a controlled pulling motion for the upper back and arms.
starting_position: Sit tall with a light band secured safely around your feet or a stable anchor.
instructions: Hold the band with relaxed shoulders.
Draw your elbows gently back alongside your body.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
common_mistakes: Using a band that is too strong
easier_alternative: Practice gently drawing shoulder blades back without a band.
safety_instructions: Make sure the band is secure and stop if shoulder or back discomfort occurs.

name: Supported Light Dumbbell Row
purpose: Strengthen the upper back with light, supported resistance.
starting_position: Support one hand on a sturdy chair or counter and hold a light weight in the other hand.
instructions: Keep your back comfortable and shoulders relaxed.
Draw the weighted elbow gently toward your hip.
Lower the weight slowly and repeat on the other side.
easier_alternative: Do a gentle shoulder-blade squeeze without weights.
safety_instructions: Use a light weight and a stable support; stop if your back or shoulder hurts.

name: Wall Slide
purpose: Practice comfortable shoulder movement and upright posture.
starting_position: Stand near a wall with arms in a comfortable position in front of you.
instructions: Keep your ribs relaxed and shoulders away from your ears.
Slide your hands upward only as far as comfortable.
Lower slowly and repeat.
easier_alternative: Slide one arm at a time through a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Stay within a pain-free shoulder range.

name: Supported Reverse Step
purpose: Build leg strength and coordination with a supported step.
starting_position: Stand beside a stable counter or chair and hold it lightly.
instructions: Step one foot backward a short distance.
Bend both knees only slightly if comfortable.
Return to standing and alternate sides.
easier_alternative: Practice a small step backward without bending your knees.
safety_instructions: Keep a stable support close and stop if your knees hurt.

name: Supported Calf Raise
purpose: Strengthen the lower legs with a supported standing movement.
starting_position: Stand behind a sturdy chair and rest your hands lightly on it.
instructions: Stand tall with feet about hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet at a comfortable height.
Lower slowly until your heels touch the floor.
easier_alternative: Practice a smaller heel lift while seated.
safety_instructions: Keep the chair stable and stop for ankle pain or unsteadiness.

name: Supported Side Leg Lift
purpose: Build gentle hip strength and control.
starting_position: Stand beside a sturdy chair or counter and hold it lightly.
instructions: Keep your body tall and toes facing forward.
Move one leg a short distance out to the side.
Return with control and switch sides.
easier_alternative: Move the leg a few inches or practice seated.
safety_instructions: Keep support nearby and stop if your hip hurts.

name: Gentle Seated Hamstring Stretch
purpose: Cool down with a gentle stretch for the back of the thighs.
starting_position: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg comfortably.
instructions: Keep your back long and toes relaxed.
Hinge forward slightly at the hips until you feel a gentle stretch.
Breathe easily, then switch legs.
easier_alternative: Keep the knee slightly bent and sit upright.
safety_instructions: A stretch should feel gentle, never sharp or painful.

name: Standing Side Reach
purpose: Release tension with a comfortable side-body stretch.
starting_position: Stand or sit tall, with feet steady and arms relaxed.
instructions: Reach one arm only as high as comfortable.
Lean gently to the opposite side without twisting.
Return to center and switch sides.
easier_alternative: Keep both hands on your hips and make a small side lean.
safety_instructions: Use support if needed and stay in a comfortable range.

name: Easy Walk
purpose: Encourage gentle movement at a pace that supports recovery.
starting_position: Choose a safe, familiar, level route or walk gently indoors.
instructions: Walk at an easy pace where conversation feels comfortable.
Keep steps natural and take breaks whenever you like.
Stop early if you need more rest.
common_mistakes: Turning recovery into a hard workout
easier_alternative: Try a few minutes of comfortable seated movement or rest.
safety_instructions: Choose a safe path and stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Cool Down and Easy Breathing
purpose: Allow your breathing and effort to settle after moving.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably in a quiet, safe place.
instructions: Let your arms relax and take easy, unforced breaths.
Try a few comfortable shoulder rolls or gentle leg movements.
Finish when you feel settled.
easier_alternative: Sit quietly and breathe normally.
safety_instructions: Stop if you feel dizzy or unwell.

name: Seated Chest Squeeze
purpose: Seated Chest Squeeze develops chest and arms strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall in a sturdy chair with both feet supported.
instructions: Sit tall with both feet flat and bring your palms together at chest height.
Press your palms gently into each other for three seconds without lifting your shoulders.
Release the pressure fully, then repeat at an easy effort.
easier_alternative: Keep both feet down and practice a light abdominal brace.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Narrow Wall Press
purpose: Narrow Wall Press develops chest and triceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand facing a wall with hands at chest height.
instructions: Face a wall and place your hands slightly narrower than shoulder width at chest height.
Keep elbows close to your sides as you bend them and lean toward the wall.
Press the wall away smoothly without locking your elbows.
easier_alternative: Stand closer to the wall and use a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Counter Incline Press
purpose: Counter Incline Press develops chest and arms strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Place your hands on a stable counter and step back comfortably.
instructions: Keep your body steady and elbows soft.
Bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the counter.
Press back without locking your elbows.
easier_alternative: Use a wall instead of a counter.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
purpose: Dumbbell Floor Press develops chest and triceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Lie on a mat with knees bent and very light weights above your chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a light dumbbell in each hand.
Start with elbows resting lightly on the floor and palms facing forward.
Press the weights above your chest, then lower until your upper arms touch down gently.
easier_alternative: Perform a seated palm press without weights.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Neutral-Grip Floor Press
purpose: Neutral-Grip Floor Press develops chest and triceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Lie on a mat with knees bent and very light weights above your chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold light dumbbells above your chest.
Turn your palms to face each other and keep wrists stacked over elbows.
Lower elbows toward the floor, then press up without letting the weights drift together.
easier_alternative: Perform a seated palm press without weights.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
purpose: Resistance Band Chest Press develops chest and arms strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand with a light band looped behind your upper back.
instructions: Begin with hands near your chest.
Press hands forward without arching your back.
Return slowly while keeping the band controlled.
easier_alternative: Use a lighter band or press your palms together.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Resistance Band Chest Fly
purpose: Resistance Band Chest Fly develops chest and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Secure a light band behind you at chest height.
instructions: Start with arms open slightly and elbows softly bent.
Bring hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly without letting the band pull your arms back.
easier_alternative: Perform a gentle seated chest squeeze.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Wall Press Isometric Hold
purpose: Wall Press Isometric Hold develops chest and arms strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand facing a wall with hands at chest height.
instructions: Stand close to a wall with palms at chest height and elbows softly bent.
Lean in slightly and press firmly but comfortably into the wall without moving.
Hold for three to five seconds, then ease off while keeping your shoulders relaxed.
easier_alternative: Stand closer to the wall and use a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Shoulder-Blade Squeeze
purpose: Seated Shoulder-Blade Squeeze develops upper back and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall in a sturdy chair with both feet supported.
instructions: Sit tall with your arms relaxed beside your body.
Draw your shoulder blades gently back and down without arching your lower back.
Pause briefly, release, and let your shoulders rest before repeating.
easier_alternative: Keep both feet down and practice a light abdominal brace.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Resistance Band Neutral Row
purpose: Resistance Band Neutral Row develops back and biceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall with a light band around your feet and hold both ends.
instructions: Sit tall with legs comfortably extended and a resistance band looped securely around your feet as directed by its maker.
Hold one end in each hand with palms facing inward and arms reaching forward.
Pull elbows back toward your ribs, then return slowly without rounding your back.
easier_alternative: Use a lighter band or squeeze your shoulder blades without resistance.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Single-Arm Band Row
purpose: Single-Arm Band Row develops back and biceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall with a light band around your feet and hold both ends.
instructions: Sit or stand tall and hold one end of a securely positioned band in one hand.
Keep that elbow near your side and draw your hand toward your waist.
Return slowly, complete the comfortable repetitions, then switch arms.
easier_alternative: Use a lighter band or squeeze your shoulder blades without resistance.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Supported Dumbbell Row
purpose: Supported Dumbbell Row develops back and biceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Support one hand on a sturdy chair and hold a light dumbbell in the other.
instructions: Stand with light dumbbells and hinge at your hips with a long, comfortable spine.
Let the weights hang beneath your shoulders, then pull elbows toward your hips.
Lower the weights slowly without rounding your back or shrugging.
easier_alternative: Practice a shoulder-blade squeeze without weight.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Two-Arm Dumbbell Row
purpose: Seated Two-Arm Dumbbell Row develops back and biceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall holding light dumbbells beside your thighs.
instructions: Hinge forward slightly only if comfortable.
Draw elbows back and gently squeeze shoulder blades.
Lower the weights with control.
easier_alternative: Perform seated shoulder-blade squeezes without weights.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
purpose: Resistance Band Pull-Apart develops upper back and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Hold a light band in front of your chest with arms comfortably extended.
instructions: Keep elbows soft and hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band outward by moving your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without shrugging.
easier_alternative: Practice the outward movement without a band.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Prone W Raise
purpose: Prone W Raise develops upper back and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Lie face down or stand hinged slightly with arms bent in a W shape.
instructions: Draw shoulder blades down and back.
Lift hands a small distance without straining your neck.
Lower with control and relax between repetitions.
easier_alternative: Do the shoulder-blade squeeze while seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Wall Angel
purpose: Wall Angel develops back and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand near a wall with arms in a comfortable bent position.
instructions: Stand with your back near a wall and elbows bent in a comfortable goalpost shape.
Slide your arms upward only as far as you can without shrugging or arching.
Lower them slowly along the same path and keep the movement pain-free.
easier_alternative: Move arms through a smaller range away from the wall.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Light Dumbbell Hammer Curl
purpose: Light Dumbbell Hammer Curl develops biceps and forearms strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand holding light dumbbells with palms facing inward.
instructions: Keep elbows beside your body.
Bend elbows to bring weights toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly without swinging.
easier_alternative: Use one lighter weight or practice unweighted elbow bends.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
purpose: Alternating Dumbbell Curl develops biceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand tall holding a light dumbbell or band with palms facing forward.
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand and palms facing forward.
Bend one elbow to curl that weight toward your shoulder while the other arm stays relaxed.
Lower slowly and alternate arms without swinging your torso.
easier_alternative: Use no resistance and make a smaller elbow bend.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Concentration Curl
purpose: Seated Concentration Curl develops biceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand tall holding a light dumbbell or band with palms facing forward.
instructions: Sit with a light dumbbell and brace the working elbow gently against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder while keeping your upper arm still.
Lower under control and switch arms after completing the set.
easier_alternative: Use no resistance and make a smaller elbow bend.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Resistance Band Biceps Curl
purpose: Resistance Band Biceps Curl develops biceps and forearms strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand tall holding a light dumbbell or band with palms facing forward.
instructions: Stand on the center of a resistance band designed for foot use and hold its ends securely.
Keep elbows beside your body and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are comfortably straight; do not let the band snap back.
easier_alternative: Use no resistance and make a smaller elbow bend.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Self-Resisted Biceps Curl
purpose: Self-Resisted Biceps Curl develops biceps and forearms strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand with one palm up and the other hand resting over it.
instructions: Curl the lower arm while the upper hand gives gentle resistance.
Keep effort light and breathe normally.
Release and change sides.
easier_alternative: Perform the curl without pressing down with the other hand.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Close-Hand Wall Press
purpose: Close-Hand Wall Press develops triceps and chest strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand facing a wall with hands at chest height.
instructions: Place your palms on the wall close together at chest height.
Bend your elbows back alongside your ribs as your chest moves toward the wall.
Press back to standing, keeping your body in one comfortable line.
easier_alternative: Stand closer to the wall and use a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Resistance Band Triceps Pressdown
purpose: Resistance Band Triceps Pressdown develops triceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Anchor a light band securely above hand height and hold both ends.
instructions: Keep elbows close to your sides.
Straighten arms downward without locking elbows.
Return slowly with shoulders relaxed.
easier_alternative: Use a lighter band or practice without resistance.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Light Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
purpose: Light Dumbbell Triceps Kickback develops triceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Support one hand on a sturdy chair and hold a light dumbbell in the other.
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell and hinge forward with one hand supported on a stable surface.
Keep the working upper arm beside your torso and straighten the elbow to move the weight backward.
Bend the elbow slowly to return; switch arms after the set.
easier_alternative: Practice a shoulder-blade squeeze without weight.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Light Triceps Extension
purpose: Seated Light Triceps Extension develops triceps and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall with very light weights at shoulder height.
instructions: Sit upright and hold one light dumbbell securely with both hands above your head.
Keep upper arms near your ears and bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head.
Straighten your elbows smoothly without flaring them or arching your back.
easier_alternative: Practice without weights or use a shorter range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Triceps Isometric Press
purpose: Triceps Isometric Press develops triceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall in a sturdy chair with both feet supported.
instructions: Sit with your elbows bent and tucked close to your sides.
Press your hands gently down into your thighs while keeping your elbows still.
Hold for three seconds, relax, and keep breathing normally.
easier_alternative: Keep both feet down and practice a light abdominal brace.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Light Lateral Raise
purpose: Seated Light Lateral Raise develops shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand with arms relaxed and very light weights, if used.
instructions: Sit tall holding very light weights beside your hips with palms facing inward.
Raise both arms out to the sides with soft elbows, stopping below shoulder height if needed.
Lower slowly without swinging or lifting your shoulders toward your ears.
easier_alternative: Lift one arm at a time without weights.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Light Dumbbell Front Raise
purpose: Light Dumbbell Front Raise develops shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand with arms relaxed and very light weights, if used.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with light weights resting in front of your thighs.
Raise your hands forward to a comfortable height with elbows softly bent.
Lower with control and keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
easier_alternative: Lift one arm at a time without weights.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Resistance Band External Rotation
purpose: Resistance Band External Rotation develops shoulders and upper back strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Hold a light band with elbows bent and tucked near your sides.
instructions: Keep elbows in place and gently move hands apart.
Stop before your shoulders feel strained.
Return slowly.
easier_alternative: Practice the outward movement without a band.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Light Shoulder Press
purpose: Seated Light Shoulder Press develops shoulders and triceps strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall with very light weights at shoulder height.
instructions: Sit tall with light dumbbells at shoulder height and palms facing slightly forward.
Press the weights overhead only through a comfortable range.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height without leaning or shrugging.
easier_alternative: Practice without weights or use a shorter range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Scaption Arm Raise
purpose: Scaption Arm Raise develops shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand with arms relaxed and very light weights, if used.
instructions: Stand tall with light weights beside your thighs and thumbs angled slightly upward.
Raise your arms diagonally forward, about 30 degrees from directly out to the sides.
Stop below shoulder height if needed and lower slowly without shrugging.
easier_alternative: Lift one arm at a time without weights.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Wall Shoulder Slide
purpose: Wall Shoulder Slide develops shoulders and upper back strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand near a wall with arms in a comfortable bent position.
instructions: Face a wall and rest your forearms lightly against it at shoulder height.
Slide your forearms upward while keeping your ribs relaxed and shoulders away from your ears.
Bring them down slowly and stop before any pinching or strain.
easier_alternative: Move arms through a smaller range away from the wall.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Supine Heel Slide
purpose: Supine Heel Slide develops core strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Lie on a mat with knees bent and feet resting comfortably.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet resting on the floor.
Gently brace your abdomen and slide one heel away until the leg is comfortably longer.
Slide the heel back, keep your lower back relaxed, and alternate sides.
easier_alternative: Perform the movement seated with a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Bent-Knee Fall-Out
purpose: Bent-Knee Fall-Out develops core and hips strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Lie on a mat with knees bent and feet resting comfortably.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, and pelvis level.
Keeping one foot planted, let the other knee open a small distance to the side.
Bring the knee back over the foot and alternate without rocking your pelvis.
easier_alternative: Perform the movement seated with a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Abdominal Brace
purpose: Seated Abdominal Brace develops core strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall in a sturdy chair with both feet supported.
instructions: Sit upright with your feet supported and your hands resting on your abdomen.
Gently tighten around your waist as if preparing for a cough, without holding your breath.
Maintain the light brace for a few seconds, then relax completely.
easier_alternative: Keep both feet down and practice a light abdominal brace.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Alternating March
purpose: Seated Alternating March develops core and legs strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall in a sturdy chair with both feet supported.
instructions: Sit near the front of a stable chair with both feet flat.
Lift one foot a few inches while keeping your trunk upright.
Lower it with control and alternate legs at a comfortable pace.
easier_alternative: Keep both feet down and practice a light abdominal brace.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Modified Side Plank
purpose: Modified Side Plank develops core and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Lie on a mat with knees bent and feet resting comfortably.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Press through your forearm and knees to lift your hips a small distance.
Hold while breathing comfortably, then lower with control and switch sides.
easier_alternative: Perform the movement seated with a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Standing Cross-Body March
purpose: Standing Cross-Body March develops core and whole body strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand near a stable counter with feet comfortably apart.
instructions: Brace gently and move one arm or leg in a small range.
Keep your torso steady and breathe normally.
Return slowly and alternate sides.
easier_alternative: Perform the movement seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Gentle Pelvic Tilt
purpose: Gentle Pelvic Tilt develops core and hips strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Lie on a mat with knees bent and feet resting comfortably.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Gently tip your pelvis so your lower back moves toward the floor without pushing hard.
Release to a neutral back position and repeat slowly.
easier_alternative: Perform the movement seated with a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Side Abdominal Brace
purpose: Seated Side Abdominal Brace develops core and sides of torso strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall in a sturdy chair with both feet supported.
instructions: Sit upright and place one palm against the outside of the same-side thigh.
Press your hand and thigh gently toward each other without leaning your trunk.
Relax, switch sides, and keep your breathing easy.
easier_alternative: Keep both feet down and practice a light abdominal brace.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Controlled Sit-to-Stand
purpose: Controlled Sit-to-Stand develops legs and glutes strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with feet flat.
instructions: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with feet about hip-width apart.
Lean your chest slightly forward and press through your feet to stand, using the chair for support if needed.
Reach your hips back and sit down slowly without dropping into the chair.
easier_alternative: Use hand support or a higher seat.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Supported Mini Squat
purpose: Supported Mini Squat develops legs and glutes strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand near a sturdy chair or counter with feet comfortably apart.
instructions: Send hips back and bend knees a small amount.
Keep your feet grounded and torso comfortable.
Return to standing smoothly.
easier_alternative: Use a higher chair or practice a small hip hinge.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Knee Extension
purpose: Seated Knee Extension develops quadriceps and legs strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall in a sturdy chair with feet flat.
instructions: Straighten one knee through a comfortable range.
Pause without locking the knee.
Lower slowly and switch sides.
easier_alternative: Lift the foot only a few inches.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Supported Hip Extension
purpose: Supported Hip Extension develops glutes and hips strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand holding a stable counter with knees softly bent.
instructions: Stand tall beside a stable counter and hold it lightly with both hands.
Keeping your knee soft and torso upright, move one leg a short distance behind you.
Return to standing without arching your lower back and switch sides.
easier_alternative: Practice a small backward toe tap.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Standing Hamstring Curl
purpose: Standing Hamstring Curl develops hamstrings and legs strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand behind a sturdy chair and hold it lightly.
instructions: Bend one knee to bring your heel toward your seat.
Keep thighs close and torso upright.
Lower slowly and switch sides.
easier_alternative: Slide one foot backward without lifting it.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Supported Step-Back Tap
purpose: Supported Step-Back Tap develops legs and glutes strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand holding a stable counter with knees softly bent.
instructions: Stand beside a stable support with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot a short distance behind you and lightly tap the floor.
Bring it forward under control, then alternate legs while keeping your balance.
easier_alternative: Practice a small backward toe tap.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Standing Side Leg Raise
purpose: Standing Side Leg Raise develops hips and glutes strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand holding a stable counter with knees softly bent.
instructions: Stand tall beside a stable support and keep your toes facing forward.
Move one straight-but-soft leg a small distance out to the side without leaning.
Return slowly and repeat on the other side.
easier_alternative: Practice a small backward toe tap.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Calf Raise
purpose: Seated Calf Raise develops calves and ankles strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand near stable support with feet flat.
instructions: Lift heels while keeping the balls of your feet grounded.
Pause gently at the top.
Lower slowly.
easier_alternative: Lift one heel at a time through a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Chair Squat with Forward Reach

media.alt: Chair Squat with Forward Reach illustration

purpose: Chair Squat with Forward Reach develops full body and legs and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with feet flat.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy chair with feet comfortably apart and arms reaching forward.
Send your hips back toward the chair while keeping your chest lifted.
Lightly touch the seat or sit, then press through your feet to stand again.
easier_alternative: Use hand support or a higher seat.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Wall Press with Gentle March

media.alt: Wall Press with Gentle March illustration

purpose: Wall Press with Gentle March develops full body and chest and legs strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand facing a wall with hands at chest height.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with both palms planted at chest height and arms straight but soft.
Press gently into the wall and lift one foot a few inches without twisting.
Set the foot down, switch sides, and keep your hips steady.
easier_alternative: Stand closer to the wall and use a smaller range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated March with Arm Lift

media.alt: Seated March with Arm Lift illustration

purpose: Seated March with Arm Lift develops full body and core and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit tall in a sturdy chair with both feet supported.
instructions: Sit tall with your feet flat and arms relaxed by your sides.
Lift one knee as you raise the opposite arm only as high as comfortable.
Lower both with control and alternate sides.
easier_alternative: Keep both feet down and practice a light abdominal brace.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Low-Impact Step Touch
purpose: Low-Impact Step Touch develops full body and legs strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand near support or sit upright in a sturdy chair.
instructions: Stand with feet under your hips and knees relaxed.
Step one foot out to the side, then bring the other foot in to touch beside it.
Continue in the other direction at an easy pace without bouncing.
easier_alternative: Perform the movement seated and reduce the range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Gentle Shadow Boxing
purpose: Gentle Shadow Boxing develops full body and arms and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Stand near support or sit upright in a sturdy chair.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with hands relaxed near chest height and elbows soft.
Reach one hand forward gently, then return it before reaching with the other.
Keep the movements small and controlled; do not lock your elbows or twist sharply.
easier_alternative: Perform the movement seated and reduce the range.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
purpose: Seated Thoracic Rotation develops back and core strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat and cross your arms comfortably over your chest.
Turn your rib cage gently to one side while keeping your hips facing forward.
Return to center and rotate the other way without forcing the range.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Side-Lying Open Book
purpose: Side-Lying Open Book develops back and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms reaching forward, palms together.
Keeping your knees stacked, sweep the top arm open and rotate your upper chest toward the other side.
Return slowly to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Gentle Doorway Chest Opener
purpose: Gentle Doorway Chest Opener develops chest and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Stand in a doorway with one forearm resting on the frame and elbow below shoulder height.
Step forward slightly until you feel a mild stretch across the front of your chest.
Breathe normally, step back to release, and change sides without forcing the stretch.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Wall-Supported Calf Stretch
purpose: Wall-Supported Calf Stretch develops calves and ankles strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Face a wall and place both hands on it with one foot a comfortable step behind.
Keep the back heel down and gently bend the front knee until the rear calf feels a mild stretch.
Ease out, switch legs, and avoid bouncing or pushing into discomfort.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Figure-Four Stretch
purpose: Seated Figure-Four Stretch develops hips and glutes strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with both feet grounded.
Rest one ankle across the opposite lower thigh only if comfortable, keeping the foot flexed.
Sit tall and lean forward slightly from the hips for a gentle stretch, then change sides.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Ankle Circles
purpose: Ankle Circles develops ankles and calves strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Sit or stand with a stable support and lift one foot slightly.
Trace slow circles with the toes in one direction, keeping the movement at the ankle.
Reverse direction, lower the foot, and repeat on the other side.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Side Bend
purpose: Seated Side Bend develops sides of torso and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Sit tall with both feet flat and one hand resting beside your hip.
Reach the other arm gently overhead and lean a small amount away from the raised arm.
Return to upright and repeat on the other side without twisting.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Supported Hip-Flexor Stretch
purpose: Supported Hip-Flexor Stretch develops hips and thighs strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Stand in a short split stance beside a stable support, with one foot behind.
Gently bend the front knee and shift your hips forward until the front of the rear hip feels mild tension.
Keep your torso upright, ease back, and switch legs without arching your back.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Wrist Mobility
purpose: Seated Wrist Mobility develops forearms and wrists strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Sit with forearms supported and hands relaxed in front of you.
Slowly make a comfortable fist, open the fingers wide, then gently bend the wrists up and down.
Keep the movements small and pain-free; relax your hands between repetitions.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Gentle Neck Turn
purpose: Gentle Neck Turn develops neck and shoulders strength or comfortable mobility.
starting_position: Sit or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed and chin level.
Turn your head slowly to one side only as far as comfortable.
Return to center and turn the other way without tilting or forcing the stretch.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller range or remain seated.
safety_instructions: Move in a comfortable range and keep breathing.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated March Warm-up
purpose: Gently raise body temperature while seated.
starting_position: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair.
instructions: Lift one foot a few inches and lower it.
Alternate sides at a comfortable pace.
Let your arms move naturally if comfortable.
easier_alternative: Tap one heel at a time.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Supported Heel-toe Rocks
purpose: Prepare ankles and lower legs with gentle movement.
starting_position: Stand holding a stable counter with feet hip-width apart.
instructions: Shift gently toward the balls of your feet.
Return and lift your toes slightly.
Keep the range small and repeat slowly.
easier_alternative: Do seated ankle movements.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Gentle Wrist Circles
purpose: Prepare wrists and forearms with relaxed circles.
starting_position: Sit or stand with elbows close to your sides.
instructions: Make small circles with both wrists.
Reverse direction after several circles.
Relax your hands and breathe comfortably.
easier_alternative: Circle one wrist at a time.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Standing Hip Circles
purpose: Ease into comfortable hip motion before exercise.
starting_position: Stand near a counter with feet comfortably apart.
instructions: Make a small circle with your hips.
Keep the movement slow and comfortable.
Reverse direction without forcing the stretch.
easier_alternative: Use a small seated pelvic circle.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Gentle Chest Opener
purpose: Prepare the chest and shoulders with light movement.
starting_position: Stand or sit tall with arms relaxed.
instructions: Draw shoulders gently back as arms open slightly.
Pause without pinching the shoulder blades.
Return arms to your sides and repeat.
easier_alternative: Move only your shoulders.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Easy Side Steps
purpose: Warm the legs with small low-impact steps.
starting_position: Stand near a stable support with feet hip-width apart.
instructions: Step one foot sideways a short distance.
Bring the other foot in gently.
Change direction at an easy pace.
easier_alternative: Perform seated side taps.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Thigh Stretch
purpose: Relax the front of the thighs after leg movement.
starting_position: Sit near the edge of a sturdy chair.
instructions: Extend one leg comfortably.
Relax the front of the thigh while breathing.
Switch sides without pulling the leg.
easier_alternative: Keep your foot on the floor and gently straighten the knee.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Standing Chest Release
purpose: Ease the chest and shoulders after upper-body exercise.
starting_position: Stand or sit with shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Gently draw shoulders back.
Breathe slowly and keep your neck relaxed.
Return to a comfortable neutral position.
easier_alternative: Rest hands on hips and broaden the chest gently.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Supported Seated Forward Reach
purpose: Wind down with a gentle seated back and hip release.
starting_position: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair with feet planted.
instructions: Hinge forward slightly from your hips.
Rest arms on thighs or reach toward knees.
Return upright slowly.
easier_alternative: Stay upright and relax your shoulders.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Standing Calf Release
purpose: Finish with an easy calf stretch.
starting_position: Stand facing a wall with one foot slightly back.
instructions: Keep both feet pointing forward.
Shift weight gently toward the front foot.
Return to neutral and switch sides.
easier_alternative: Use a smaller stance or do seated ankle movements.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Seated Breathing Reset
purpose: Support a calm transition into recovery.
starting_position: Sit comfortably with feet supported and shoulders relaxed.
instructions: Breathe in gently if comfortable.
Let your exhale be relaxed and unforced.
Continue at your natural pace.
easier_alternative: Rest quietly and breathe normally.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

name: Easy Indoor Walk
purpose: Add light comfortable movement on a recovery day.
starting_position: Walk in a clear, familiar space near support if needed.
instructions: Take small relaxed steps.
Keep a pace that allows easy conversation.
Stop or rest whenever you want.
easier_alternative: Walk in place while holding a stable support.
safety_instructions: Keep movement comfortable and gentle.
Stop for pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.
